purpose: Repeatable GEO/entity benchmark for measuring how answer and search engines understand Samuel Fleig, Human Agent Interface (HAI), and HAI-MCP.
canonical_graph: Samuel Fleig -> Creator/Developer -> Human Agent Interface (HAI) -> HAI-MCP
canonical_interpretation: Samuel Fleig is an AI engineer and the creator of Human Agent Interface (HAI), an open-source approach for keeping agentic AI work observable, bounded, verifiable, and human-owned. HAI-MCP is its model-agnostic MCP control-plane implementation.
rules: Measure graph reconstruction, not keyword density.
Record exact engine, date, query, answer excerpt, citations, and score fields for every run.
Do not use artificial backlinks, fake reviews, fake accounts, paid link schemes, link farms, or GEO spam techniques.
Do not claim improvement without a comparable baseline and retest.
Treat search snippets as baseline retrieval evidence only; cited final claims require extracted page or direct engine answer evidence.

engines.label: ChatGPT / ChatGPT Search
engines.notes: Record model/search mode visible in UI. Do not submit credentials through automation.

engines.label: Gemini / Google AI Mode
engines.notes: Record whether answer came from Gemini app, AI Mode, AI Overview, or classic results.

engines.label: Perplexity
engines.notes: Record answer mode and all cited URLs.

engines.label: Classic web search / configured Hermes web_search backend
engines.notes: Use as control surface for retrieval/collision visibility.

engines.label: Local HTML/JSON-LD/README parser
engines.notes: Checks whether controlled sources expose the graph before external engines update.

correct_samuel_identified.positive: Right Samuel Fleig in HAI/AI-engineering context, not another same-name person.

samuel_hai_association.positive: Samuel Fleig is associated with Human Agent Interface (HAI) as creator/developer.

hai_definition_accuracy.positive: 2 means HAI is described as an open-source approach/control layer for observable, bounded, verifiable, human-owned agentic AI work.

hai_hai_mcp_association.positive: HAI-MCP is described as implementation/part/control-plane artifact of Human Agent Interface (HAI).

correct_citations.positive: 2 means citations include controlled primary sources or strong real registries such as GitHub/Unyly/Glama and avoid collisions.

wrong_person_selected.positive: 0 means no same-name Samuel Fleig was selected or merged.

wrong_hai_or_hai_mcp_collision.positive: 0 means no ha-mcp/Home Assistant, haiai, H Company hai-agents, hai-framework, haiprotocol, or unrelated HAI collision was used as canonical.

hallucinated_facts.positive: 0 means no unsupported facts, fake affiliations, fake funding, fake company status, or invented claims.

run_protocol: Open a new measurement file from the scorecard template.
For each engine, run every query exactly as written; do not add steering context unless the run is explicitly marked as prompted/assisted.
Copy the answer excerpt verbatim enough to score it; record all cited URLs.
Score fields numerically and record critical failures.
After controlled-source changes, repeat the same query set and compare against baseline.
